title: Clinton's televised statement on Rock 84001
summary: Bill Clinton tells of Clinton's televised statement on Rock 84001, about 1996 at Washington, D.C., and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: today Rock 841 speaks to us across all those billions of years and millions of miles it speaks of the possibility of life

plain: In 1996 President Bill Clinton spoke on television about a rock known as 84001, a meteorite believed to have come from Mars. He said the rock speaks to us across billions of years and millions of miles of the possibility of life, which is why it is cited as an official nod to life beyond Earth.
